Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
A vampire in the uncontrolled region with Cadet on them is not a valid target for Reunion Kamut, are they? The reason for this is that Cadet states "While this Sabbat vampire is controlled, he or she is Black Hand," meaning that it is only Black Hand in the controlled region. Why the designers would do this, I have no idea.

Reunion Kamut
Action
+1 stealth action. Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Move 2 blood from the blood bank to a Black Hand vampire in your uncontrolled region.

Cadet
Master. Trifle.
Put this card on a Sabbat vampire in your uncontrolled region who is not Black Hand. While this Sabbat vampire is controlled, he or she is Black Hand. This card remains in play, even when the vampire is in the uncontrolled region. A minion may have only one Cadet.

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.
-Friedrich Nietzsche
